name: AC Hotel by Marriott Manila
short_description: AC Hotels by Marriott's first Philippine property, a design-forward tower hotel high in Ortigas Center's LEED-Platinum GLAS Tower, with a 57th-floor indoor pool and 61st-floor rooftop bar.
ai_summary: AC Hotel by Marriott Manila is the AC Hotels brand's first property in the Philippines, opened in late 2025 and formally launched in 2026 inside the LEED Platinum-certified, all-glass GLAS Tower in Ortigas Center, Pasig City. Occupying upper floors of the 61-storey tower, it offers 160 rooms and suites, an elevated 38th-floor lobby with an AC Lounge and AC Library, a 57th-floor indoor pool and 24-hour fitness center, and a 61st-floor rooftop AC Bar. Independent coverage from Philippine outlets consistently praises the European-inspired, minimalist design, the double-glazed floor-to-ceiling glass with panoramic skyline, golf course and sunset views, high ceilings up to 3.6 meters, and the cuisine at all-day-dining AC Kitchen, which some early guests rated among the best in the district. The property is pet-friendly and geared to business travelers, sitting minutes from The Podium, SM Megamall and Ortigas corporate hubs. As a brand-new opening, genuine guest feedback is still thin and mixed: while design, food and views draw praise, some early reviews flagged inconsistent service and room rates that feel high for a select-service tier. Marriott Bonvoy members earn and redeem points here, though dedicated executive-lounge elite benefits are limited by the select-service format.

core_facts.address: GLAS Tower, corner Ruby and Opal Road, Ortigas Center, Pasig City, Metro Manila, Philippines

faqs.question: Where is AC Hotel by Marriott Manila located?
faqs.answer: It occupies the upper floors of the GLAS Tower at the corner of Ruby and Opal Road in Ortigas Center, Pasig City, in Metro Manila. The location is walkable to The Podium and SM Megamall and roughly a 25 to 40 minute drive from Ninoy Aquino International Airport depending on traffic.

faqs.question: What dining and amenities does the hotel offer?
faqs.answer: The all-day AC Kitchen serves European and Filipino dishes, while the AC Lounge and 61st-floor rooftop AC Bar handle tapas and cocktails. Guests also get a 57th-floor indoor swimming pool, a 24-hour fitness center, the AC Library workspace, an AC Store, and extensive meeting and ballroom event space.

faqs.question: Is this a good pick for Marriott Bonvoy members?
faqs.answer: Yes for earning and redeeming Bonvoy points, and the design, views and food stand out. However, as a select-service AC Hotel it does not offer a full executive lounge, so elite guests expecting extensive lounge benefits should set expectations accordingly at this brand-new property.
